claims.statement: Long-term target of 25% EBITDA margin, 25% ROCE, and double-digit growth
R&D spend guidance for FY25 at 8.5% to 9% of sales
Normal effective tax rate expected at 24% to 25%
Capex primarily for expansion (75%) in API, injectables, biologics, and Aurigene; over 50% directed to products for launch and capacity creation
Building additional capacity in biologics plant at Bachupally and APSL services for biologics and small molecules
Plan to launch 20+ products in US market in FY25
21 global generic filings in Q4 FY24 including 9 ANDAs and 1 NDA in US; 43 global filings for FY24 with 17 ANDAs and 2 NDAs in US
Consolidated gross margin 58.6% in Q4 FY24, up 140 bps YoY; FY24 gross margin 58.6%, up 193 bps YoY
EBITDA margin 26.4% in Q4 FY24, up 53 bps YoY; FY24 EBITDA margin 29.7%, flat YoY
SG&A as % of sales 27.7% for FY24, flat YoY; expected to remain in similar range over next 12 months
Acquired portfolio generated GBP 217 million revenue in 2023 with steady sales and healthy profitability
Acquisition is margin-accretive and expected to be in line with normal 25% EBITDA margin guidelines
Management targets 25% EBITDA margin as a decision point, using excess to reinvest in brand growth
Long-term ROCE target maintained at 25% on average alongside double-digit growth and 25% EBITDA
Current global OTC business approximately $300 million, North American OTC about $140 million
Aiming for OTC business to reach billions in revenue over time through organic growth and acquisitions
Business is asset-light with no manufacturing facilities; served by long-standing CMO relationships in Europe (20+ years)
Plans to increase A&P investment and consumer understanding capabilities to grow the business
Will continue evaluating value-creating inorganic opportunities across geographies including India while focusing on integration
SG&A expected at 27.5-28% of sales for full fiscal
R&D spend expected at 8.5-9% of sales for full fiscal
Effective tax rate expected at 24-25% for fiscal
US generics business expected to grow in single digits year-on-year excluding lenalidomide
India base business expected to grow double digits for the year
Capital investments of Rs 491 crores in Q1FY25
Bachupally biologics facility expansion to 50 KL over next two years from current 15 KL
Aurigene CDMO biologics facility investment of few hundred crores
Aurigene inaugurated 70,000 sq.ft. CDMO biologics facility in Hyderabad
Bachupally facility current capacity 15 KL targeting 50 KL
Nicotinell acquisition expected to close early Q4 CY2024 adding ~$300M revenue
Consumer healthcare portfolio currently ~$320M, with Nicotinell addition reaching $600M+
Nestlé JV operational from August 1st combining both companies' nutraceutical products
Normalized ETR expected around 25% for the fiscal
North America generics to continue growing on base products
Denosumab US filing by end of calendar year 2024
Abatacept biosimilar launch targeted for early calendar 2027
Rituximab biosimilar Europe launch planned for February 2025
Rituximab biosimilar US approval likely in first half of FY26
SG&A growth to be flat to moderate going forward
SG&A to remain around 28% range beyond FY26
Capex cash outflow Rs 735 crore in Q2 FY25
~50% of capex allocated to API capacity for GLP-1 and peptides
Injectables, biosimilars and peptides/API are key capex focus areas
North America generics to close FY25 with 15-20 product launches
Emerging Markets generics launched 22 new products in Q2 FY25
India business launched 3 brands in Q2 FY25
PSAI filed 22 DMFs globally in Q2 FY25
Made 60 global generic filings including 2 US ANDAs in Q2 FY25
Consolidated gross margin 59.6% in Q2 FY25, up 92 bps YoY, down 81 bps QoQ
EBITDA margin 28.4% in Q2 FY25, down 326 bps YoY, up 30 bps QoQ
Underlying EBITDA margin 29.1% excluding one-time acquisition cost
Global Generics gross margin 63%, PSAI gross margin 30% in Q2 FY25
R&D spend expected at 8.5-9% of sales for full fiscal year
Normalized effective tax rate expected around 25%
SG&A expenses expected to stay around 28% of sales going forward
Capex cash outflow was Rs. 709 crores ($83 million) in Q3FY25
Working on Semaglutide capacity including API, formulation and device access for last 10 years
Made 53 global generic filings during Q3FY25
Consolidated gross profit margin at 59%, up 19 bps YoY, down 91 bps QoQ
EBITDA margin at 27.5%, down 176 bps YoY and 95 bps QoQ
FY26 double-digit revenue growth and EBITDA margin 25%+ expected
FY26 ETR expected similar to FY25 level
FY26 capex expected in similar range as FY25
NRT business full-year FY26 revenue around ₹2,400 crores
Q4 consolidated gross margin 55.6%, down 300 bps YoY and 312 bps QoQ
FY25 consolidated gross margin stable at 58.5%
Q4 EBITDA margin 29.1%, up 267 bps YoY and 160 bps QoQ
FY25 EBITDA margin 28.3%, down 143 bps YoY
NRT business EBITDA margin zone of 25%
US price erosion very low single-digit in FY25
R&D: 249 global generic filings in FY25; 95 in Q4
Semaglutide launch targeted calendar 2026 in markets where IP allows
Abatacept Phase III ongoing; filing targeted end of CY2025
FY26 R&D spend expected at 7-7.5% of sales
FY26 SG&A expected at 28-29% of sales
FY26 capex cash outflow expected at ₹2,500-2,700 crores
FY26 normalized ETR expected around 25%
US base business expected flat to single-digit growth in FY26
Semaglutide US approval targeted end of October to beginning of November 2025 for January 2026 launch

claims.statement: Semaglutide capacity 10 million pens calendar 2026, 12 million pens FY27 via partner
Abatacept biosimilar Phase III readout November 2025, BLA submission targeting December 2026/January 2027 launch
Discretionary cost savings potential of 500-600 bps identified across R&D and SG&A
R&D spend flexibility down to 6% of sales if needed
PLI income near zero for FY26, expected again in FY27-28
Consolidated gross margin 56.9%, down 350 bps YoY due to Lenalidomide price erosion, up 134 bps QoQ
PSAI gross margin 13.2% due to seasonal weakness and under-recovery of overheads from lower internal sales
Vizag peptide capacity for Semaglutide from FY28 onwards, FY26-27 supply via partner
Semaglutide portfolio includes 26 GLP-1 products in pipeline
Capex ₹511 Cr
Management maintains commitment to return to 25% EBITDA margin in next two years (FY27) despite Lenalidomide decline
SG&A expected to be 28-30% of revenues for modelling purposes
PSAI gross margin expected to be 20-25% going forward
Q2FY26 EBITDA margin 26.7%, underlying 27.5% excluding one-time VAT provision
Gross margin declined 492 bps YoY to 54.7% due to lower Lenalidomide sales, price erosion, inventory provisions and lower PSAI operating leverage
12 million Semaglutide pens planned for launch across 87 countries in next 12-15 months
Semaglutide volume could increase to 15 million pens in 2027 with FTO-11 capacity ramp-up
Q2FY26 capex cash outflow ₹511 crores ($58 million)
Two cartridge fill-finish lines at FTO-11 for Semaglutide, capacity up to 50 million units, ready after next 12 months
CTO-6 API capacity for peptides up to 800 kg, currently far from full utilization
India business organic growth guided at 15-16% sustainable for FY27
Global Generics and PSAI gross margin guided at 50-55% range from Q4 FY26 without Lenalidomide
R&D spend guided at 7-8% of revenues for FY27
SG&A growth pace to be less than half of top-line growth in FY27
Semaglutide Canada launch expected between end of February and May 2026
Semaglutide India launch scheduled for March 21, 2026
Semaglutide Brazil and Turkey launches expected around July 2026
Denosumab US approval likely in Q2 FY27 or later
Rituximab US approval unlikely in next 6 months
Abatacept IV US approval expected end of calendar 2026; SC approval by Jan-Feb 2028
Abatacept Europe filing in July 2026, launch expected July 2027
NRT integration largely complete by end of FY26
CDMO business expected to add $100M+ revenue in next 2-3 years
Reported EBITDA margin 23.5% in Q3 FY26; adjusted for one-time labour provision 24.8%
Global Generics gross margin 57.4%; PSAI gross margin 17.3% in Q3 FY26
NRT business EBITDA margin currently above 25% but guided at 25% steady state
Labour Codes provision Rs 117 crore retrospective; future impact <50 bps
Capex cash outflow Rs 669 crore (US$75M) in Q3 FY26
Semaglutide capacity 12 million pens currently; additional capacity planned later
Updated FY27 semaglutide pen sales guidance to 6-7 million pens due to supply disruption
Previous guidance assumed sales in July-October now unlikely due to validation failure
Commercial supply to OneSource expected to resume in October after validation batches
Captive fill-finish facility timeline delayed by a few months but plans remain valid
Partners informed of supply disruption; some have alternatives, relationships maintained
EBITDA margin target of 20%+ unchanged despite near-term volume miss
Inventory write-down likely for batches associated with OneSource validation failure
Management maintains EBITDA margin guidance in the neighbourhood of 20% for next quarter without semaglutide, expecting higher margins upon semaglutide resumption in November.
Full-year FY27 capex guidance is around ₹1,800 crores, expected to stay at similar levels next year due to ongoing biosimilar and peptide investments.
Normalized full-year effective tax rate guided at 24-25% and R&D spend at 7-8% of revenues.
Reported EBITDA margin was 12.5%; excluding semaglutide provision and related impacts, margin would have been around 18% (high-teens).
Gross margin declined 1,039 bps YoY to 46.5% due to lower lenalidomide sales, semaglutide provision, and higher solvent costs from Middle East conflict.
Middle East conflict impact on solvents and freight is close to 1% of EBITDA and expected to persist at least until December.
Semaglutide pen supply target is 6-7 million pens between November and March across multiple markets, backed by partner orders.
Semaglutide API theoretical capacity can reach 550 units, current capacity north of 300 units, sufficient for both captive and third-party supply.
Semaglutide API commercial supplies planned to resume by November after completing testing by third week of September.
USFDA Pre-License Inspection at Bachupally biologics facility completed in June 2026 with 7 observations; response submitted within timelines.
